themes.mechanism: Two full token sets under :root[data-theme="light"] (also the :root default) and :root[data-theme="dark"], same custom-property names. Frontmatter keys ending in -dark are the dark values of the same CSS variable.
themes.toggle: Light / Dark / System segmented radio group in the rail foot (lucide Sun, Moon, Monitor).
themes.boot: Inline script in index.html reads the key and sets data-theme and color-scheme before first paint; System follows prefers-color-scheme live via a matchMedia listener; storage failures fall back to system.

headline.purpose: One page title per step, panel head. text-wrap: balance.

body.purpose: Running copy, rows, buttons. Tabular figures on body. Ledes in text-2, max 64ch.

body-sm.purpose: Option rows, notices, warning lists, check status, install rows.

label.purpose: Hints, legends, step count, paths, install state.

mono-data.purpose: Versions and paths everywhere (600 in version pickers).

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Selected lift: current step and active theme segment only.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on every :focus-visible, replacing outline.

motion.name: step-enter
motion.purpose: One entrance per step body; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover/focus state changes on controls and rows.

motion.name: spin
motion.value: 0.8s linear infinite (spinner), 0.9s (running install icon); 2.4s under reduced motion

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: rail becomes top bar, steps hidden, toggle right at 220px, 16px gutters, data grids to two columns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single next action of a view (Continue, Install, Retry).

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as Cancel or Rescan after an error.

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Back, Rescan and Edit; label aligns to the content edge.

components.name: Path Field
components.description: Labelled text field; paths and ports use the mono data voice.

components.css: .ds-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;max-width:780px;background:var(--surface,#fff);border:1px solid var(--border,#e1e4e9);border-radius:8px;font:14px/1.5 "Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text,#16181d);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:6px 10px;padding:10px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border,#e1e4e9)}.ds-row:first-child{border-top:0}.ds-ic{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--text-3,#636a77)}.ds-ok .ds-ic{background:var(--ok,#127436);color:var(--surface,#fff)}.ds-run .ds-ic{color:var(--accent-text,#1c4fd6)}.ds-run .ds-ic svg{animation:ds-spin .9s linear infinite}.ds-wait>span:nth-child(2){color:var(--text-3,#636a77)}.ds-state{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3,#636a77);text-align:right}.ds-run .ds-state{color:var(--text-2,#464d5a)}.ds-bar{grid-column:2/-1;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--border,#e1e4e9);overflow:hidden}.ds-bar span{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent,#2563eb)}@keyframes ds-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-run .ds-ic svg{animation-duration:2.4s}}

narrative.overview:
A Windows-native setup tool built to the category standard of Laravel Herd, Docker Desktop, GitHub Desktop and Linear. The window is a calm sidebar wizard: a slightly tinted rail on the left, a white (or near-black) work panel on the right, hairline-bordered lists in the middle and a footer bar at the bottom. Every number lines up, every state is honest, and nothing decorative stands in for clarity.

Colour is spent on meaning only. One confident blue marks selection, the current position, the focus ring and the primary action; green, amber and red appear only for done, warning and failure. Everything else is cool neutral greys arranged as tonal layers. Data (versions, paths) speaks in a monospace voice, all figures are tabular, and icons come from one line-icon library.

Both themes are first-class. Light and dark are full token sets switched by `data-theme` on the root element, chosen with a Light / Dark / System toggle and applied before first paint.
keyCharacteristics: Two-column shell: 232px tinted rail, flexible work panel, content capped at a 780px column.
Flat tonal layering with hairline borders; one soft shadow, used only to lift a selected item in a segmented set.
Segoe UI Variable (Display for headings, Text for body) with tabular figures; Cascadia Mono for data.
Blue only for selection, current, focus and primary action; status colours only for status.
Lucide line icons only; no glyph characters as icons, no eyebrow labels.
One entrance motion per step, removed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "this is chosen, this is where you are, this has focus, or this is the next action." It never decorates, never labels a category and never marks a recommendation.

rules.name: The Earned Status Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only when something is done, needs attention or has failed. A neutral fact is never coloured to look good.

rules.name: The Inverted Recommendation Rule
rules.body: "Recommended" is a neutral inverted tag (`text` background, `surface` text) so it stands out without borrowing blue or green.

rules.name: The Data Voice Rule
rules.body: Versions and filesystem paths are always set in the mono family; prose never is.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set on the body so every count, size and version column aligns.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone. There is no small label, kicker or category line above a page or section title.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Lists, cards and panels carry a hairline, never a shadow. A shadow means "selected in a set," and the ring means focus.

dos: Do reserve blue (`accent`) for selection, the current step, the focus ring and the single primary action.
Do use green, amber and red only for done, warning and failure states.
Do show "Recommended" as the neutral inverted tag (ink fill, surface text).
Do set versions and paths in Cascadia Mono at 12.5px, and keep tabular figures on.
Do use lucide line icons at 12-14px for every icon.
Do keep content within the 780px column and align the footer's primary action to its right edge.
Do show disabled states with `text-3` (and `surface-2` for a disabled primary).
Do define every colour for both themes under the same token name, and keep the Light / Dark / System toggle stored in `devmanager.theme` and applied before first paint.
Do give each step one entrance motion and remove it under reduced motion.
donts: Don't put eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
Don't use text glyphs (check marks, arrows, bullets, stars) as icons.
Don't use opacity to show a disabled control.
Don't colour recommendations, categories or neutral facts with blue or a status hue.
Don't add shadows to lists, cards or panels; depth is tonal and hairline.
Don't set prose in the mono family.
